scope: Twelve proposed condition-icon repaints, preserving existing paths and mappings. The other fifteen condition icons are retained.

previews.comparison.webp: Final WebP files before and after at 96, 40, 20 and 16 pixels on dark and light surrounds.
previews.badge-comparison.webp: Raster approximation of the current circular GameIcon badge, including padding and 1.25 image scale; not a browser screenshot.
previews.index.html: Standalone gallery with raw images and the current GameIcon CSS presentation. Open from the checkout to resolve relative image paths.

findings: Blessed, dodging, hidden, incapacitated, invisible and petrified no longer depend on near-black silhouettes on the dark badge.
Blinded uses a broad red blindfold; deafened uses a crossed-out ear. These remain separate shapes at small sizes.
Restrained uses intact rope-bound wrists, separate from the existing grappled arm and hand.
Prone retains a horizontal conscious figure, while unconscious uses a closed-eyed resting head and moon. Exhaustion uses a weary head with a downturned mouth.
The original invisible sheet crop showed neighbouring sprite residue. A separate generation replaces it; both prompts and source images are retained.
All shipped icons use a 104px content box in a 128px transparent square to allow for the current 1.25 badge scaling.
Detailed faces and the dodging arrow are easier to interpret at 40px than 16px. Existing text labels remain necessary; this is not an icon-only usability study.
